root_cause.text: In EROFS, z_erofs_decompress_kickoff() queued asynchronous decompression work before reading/updating sbi->sync_decompress, so the superblock-private sbi could be freed during unmount and then dereferenced, causing a UAF race.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly shows queue_work leading to z_erofs_decompressqueue_work(), then unmount freeing sbi via erofs_sb_free/kfree(sbi), followed by “access sbi->sync_decompress // UAF!!”; the patch fixes this by moving the sbi->sync_decompress check/update to before queue_work().

agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE/commit explicitly shows queue_work leading to z_erofs_decompressqueue_work(), then unmount freeing sbi via erofs_sb_free/kfree(sbi), followed by “access sbi->sync_decompress // UAF!!”; the patch fixes this by moving the sbi->sync_decompress check/update to before queue_work().

intent_record.intent_summary: Force synchronous decompression when atomic-context decompression is detected and sync_decompress is still in AUTO mode.
intent_record.what: Inside z_erofs_decompress_kickoff(), within the existing z_erofs_in_atomic() conditional, the change adds a comment and a new check that tests whether sbi->sync_decompress equals EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO and, if so, assigns it to EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON before the existing CONFIG_EROFS_FS_PCPU_KTHREAD code.
intent_record.how: When decompression kickoff happens in atomic context, the filesystem now permanently switches sync_decompress from AUTO to FORCE_ON, causing subsequent decompression handling to use forced synchronous decompression instead of leaving it in automatic mode; this avoids relying on behavior that may be unsafe or unsuitable in atomic context.

intent_record.intent_summary: Stop decompression kickoff from implicitly changing sync_decompress from AUTO to FORCE_ON after scheduling work.
intent_record.what: The change removes a three-line block from z_erofs_decompress_kickoff() that, after queueing decompression work, checked whether sbi->sync_decompress was EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO and then reassigned it to EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON before returning.
intent_record.how: At runtime, queueing decompression work no longer mutates the filesystem's sync_decompress mode from AUTO to FORCE_ON, so the AUTO setting is preserved instead of being permanently escalated after this execution path.

grouping_result.intent: Force synchronous decompression when atomic-context decompression is detected and sync_decompress is still in AUTO mode.
Stop decompression kickoff from implicitly changing sync_decompress from AUTO to FORCE_ON after scheduling work.

relevance_review.reason: The change chooses synchronous decompression in atomic context when sync_decompress is AUTO, but it does not address the specific UAF race caused by queuing async work before safely reading/updating sbi->sync_decompress during unmount.

The change directly targets z_erofs_decompress_kickoff() behavior around sync_decompress during async decompression kickoff, which is the same control flow involved in the UAF race caused by accessing/updating sbi->sync_decompress after queuing work.

candidates.rationale: This schedules asynchronous decompression work before checking or updating sbi->sync_decompress, creating the race window where unmount can free sbi and later code dereferences it.
This dereferences sbi after async work has already been queued, so if unmount freed the superblock-private sbi in the meantime, this read becomes a use-after-free.
This writes to sbi after async work was queued, and is directly unsafe if sbi has been freed during the race with unmount.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement initiates asynchronous decompression work before sbi->sync_decompress is checked or updated, creating the race window described in the root cause: unmount can free the superblock-private sbi and later statements in this function then dereference it, leading to a use-after-free.

This statement reads sbi->sync_decompress after async work has already been queued. Because the prior scheduling opened a race with unmount, sbi may already have been freed, making this dereference part of the UAF.
This statement writes through sbi after async work was queued. If unmount freed sbi during that race window, this becomes a direct use-after-free write.
